items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I opened at the National Scholar with the Edgar Well Thomas' Band. ... I worked with him

ctx.x: Yes, in the '30's. I'll bring some of the programs to you so you can see them. I think it's '34, '35, '36. I had standing contracts after that to go twice a year. I opened at the National Scholar with the Edgar Well Thomas' Band. Edgar Well Thomas, he had a band, and he was tremendous.

I worked with him, and thank the Lord, I was a tremendous success. I'd leave out of the Scholar, which was the big theater, and go right downstairs in the little bar, the little bar downstairs. And the fellow that played there, I hope I can think of his name, Chris. He was marvelous.
